title: British Airways grounded itself by unplugging the IT
body: In May 2017 a power supply at a BA datacenter was accidentally disconnected, and the uncontrolled shutdown and restart damaged systems so severely that most flights were cancelled for days, affecting about 75,000 passengers. The inquiry narrative is unglamorous: power, procedure, restart order. Airlines run on reservation systems the way fish run on water, invisibly until absence.
source_hint: British Airways / press and regulator reporting (2017)
